Initialize.description: Initialize connection to the wafer prober with two modes: Manual (direct connection) or Database (interactive selection)

address.description: Prober network address (REQUIRED for manual mode, format: 'host:port')

machineType.description: Type of prober (REQUIRED for manual mode, value: 'sentio')

projectName.description: Project name to open (optional, auto-opens .prj file)

alignmentDie.description: Alignment die position as 'col,row,subsite' (e.g., '2,2,0'). Used by AlignWafer if not specified.

homeDie.description: Home die position as 'col,row,subsite' (e.g., '5,2,0'). Used by FindHome if not specified.

withDB.description: Use database mode for interactive initialization

Initialize.notes: MANUAL MODE: Provide address and machineType. DATABASE MODE: Interactive flow selects prober/ASIC/orientation/project. Die positions stored for AlignWafer and FindHome commands.

Load.description: Load a wafer onto the chuck

Unload.description: Unload the wafer from the chuck

FindHome.description: Find the home position of the chuck. Uses home die from initialization if not specified.

homeDie_col.description: Home die column (optional if set during initialization)

homeDie_row.description: Home die row (optional if set during initialization)

FindHome.notes: If homeDie was set during initialization, it will automatically use that position. Otherwise performs default FindHome.

AlignWafer.description: Perform wafer alignment. Uses alignment die from initialization if not specified.

align_die_col.description: Alignment die column (optional if set during initialization)

align_die_row.description: Alignment die row (optional if set during initialization)

AlignWafer.notes: If alignmentDie was set during initialization, it will automatically use that position. Otherwise requires homeDie_col and homeDie_row parameters.

MoveChuckXY.description: Move the chuck to specified X,Y coordinates

MoveChuckZ.description: Move the chuck to specified Z coordinate

GoToDie.description: Move to a specific die on the wafer

GoToPreviousDie.description: Move to the previous die in the sequence

StepNextDie.description: Step to the next die in the sequence

MoveChuckToWorkArea.description: Move chuck to the work area

work_area.description: Working position to switch to. Available for MPI Probe Station: Probing, OffAxis

mountPoint.description: Camera position to switch to. Available for MPI Probe Station: Vce, OffAxis, Scope, Chuck

GetCameraStatus.description: Get current camera status and information

Cleaning.notes: This command is not yet implemented

RunSequencer.description: Execute a sequence of commands from a JSON file

ShowProjectStatus.description: Display current project status, connection info, die position, and wafer information
ShowProjectStatus.notes: Shows prober connection, project name, agent state, current die position, and total die count

GetInfo.description: Display current die position and wafer map information

GetAgentState.description: Get current agent state machine status

ReconnectProber.description: Reconnect to the prober after the machine was powered off or restarted, without restarting WPAgent
ReconnectProber.notes: Expert or Developer. Forgets the old session (project, die, chuck position, testing lock) and returns to UserLogged: run OpenProject and InitProbing afterwards. If the machine is not reachable yet nothing changes; run it again.

ResetAgent.description: Reset agent state machine to Idle (recovery command)
ResetAgent.notes: Use this when agent is stuck in Failed state

GetChuckPosition.description: Get current chuck position status (In Contact or In Separation)

SaveChuckPosition.description: Read the chuck X/Y (Zero reference), contact height and current die, and save them in Contacting/<project>/positions.json. Moves nothing.

label.description: Die label, e.g. BAM00 (the prober only reports col/row)

AnalyzeNeedleMarks.description: Needle-mark analysis of the newest stitched LEC image of a die folder. Reports (JSON, CSV, overlay) are written next to the image in Imaging/<wafer>/<folder>/. No prober movement.

config.description: needle_mark config: built-in name (default lec) or JSON path

pattern.description: Stitched image to analyse (default *_LEC.tif, newest is used)

contrast.description: Also write the contrast image (default false)

require_ok.description: Fail when pad count or sizes do not match the config (default false)

root.description: Top folder: Imaging (default) or the EOS archive

ComputePadTargetOffset.description: Chuck offset to a target on the pads (corner + inset, or center) from the newest needle-mark report of a die. Requires one round mark per pad. Saved in Contacting/<project>/offsets.json. No prober movement.

root.description: Top folder: Imaging (default) or the EOS archive

inset_um.description: Distance from both pad edges of the corner (default 20)

name.description: Name of the saved offset (default pad_target)

min_valid_fraction.description: Fraction of pads that must have one round mark (default 1.0)

TakeImageLECDie.description: LEC imaging of one die (label or col+row): raster, stitch, cleanup, archive. Images in Imaging/<wafer>/<die>/, then archived.

NeedleOffsetMeasureER2B.description: Part 1 of pad-target contacting on ER2B: PTPA, save position, contact, LEC image of the die, needle-mark analysis and chuck offset to the pad target.

LocalMode.description: Put probe station into local mode
LocalMode.notes: Automatically called after errors to return control to manual operation

ListProbers.description: List all available probers from database

ListChipTypes.description: List all available chip types from database

ListOrientations.description: List all available wafer orientations from database

command.description: Specific command to get help for
